title: build_index_json does not JSON-escape group names — invalid JSON if names contain special chars
description: ipns_publisher.rs build_index_json manually constructs JSON by push_str of group name strings without escaping. A group name containing a double-quote or backslash (e.g. from a peer that bypassed GroupName::new validation) produces invalid JSON. Use serde_json to serialize the BTreeMap instead of hand-rolling the JSON.
